summary: Notebook on-disk store (only notebookExists and initSkeleton were read). notebookExists is just existsSync on the notebook dir (.coldstart/notebook), so any directory there counts as a notebook. initSkeleton is idempotent: creates .raw/, notes/ and the metrics dir plus okf.yaml (okf_version + coldstart_kb: 1), and its gitignore of derived files is what commit.ts and durable-worklist.ts rely on; it deliberately does NOT touch hooks or coldstart.md (that is kb init's wiring layer).
